purpose: Teach: くっつけ/談笑/オット/奥底/仇/ぶさ/里帰り/見いだす

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ステッカーをカップにくっつけ過ぎないようにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't stick too many stickers on the cups, okay?
lines.style: Gentle correction, warm but clear. Light touch on the directive. The tone of someone guiding rather than scolding. Soft finish.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人と談笑されて楽しそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer with their friend looked so happy chatting away.
lines.style: Observant, pleased. A soft smile in the voice. Noticing the small joy in her cafe. Warm and genuine, not performing appreciation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オット様とお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer came in with their husband today.
lines.style: Gentle reflection, noting a detail without emphasis. Quiet noticing. The tone of someone who pays attention to regulars and remembers their lives.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーの香りに奥底まで満たされる、と仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said the coffee aroma fills them all the way through.
lines.style: Tender and wondering. Soft voice appreciating the poetry in what was said. A small pause before speaking, as if holding something precious. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、他店を仇のように見ない方が良いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, it's better not to see other cafes as rivals, you know?
lines.style: Gentle wisdom without lecture. A light hand on something Aoi might be feeling. Kind but clear. The tone of someone who sees worry and addresses it softly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の「ぶさ可愛い」表情を撮ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was taking photos of their child's adorably ugly expression.
lines.style: Wry, small smile underneath. A knowing lightness. Not mocking—appreciating the tenderness in an awkward parenting moment. Dry observation with warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お盆休みに里帰りされるスタッフを支えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's take care of the staff heading home for Obon break.
lines.style: Quiet direction, earnest. The tone of someone who thinks of the people around her. No drama—just steady care put into words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに価値を見いだすお客様が増えたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, more and more customers are finding value in the new menu.
lines.style: Pleased observation, closing warmth. A gentle note of satisfaction. Noticing growth without fanfare. Soft, affirming, like a quiet nod.
